choice.basis: The chart shows the 2013 application volume for the United States as 1257.35 and for Canada as 434.33. Since 1257.35 > 434.33, the United States has the larger 2013 volume. The public task requires opening the country grant intake follow-up record for the country with the larger 2013 volume, which is the United States.
choice.option_label: Open 2013 United States grant intake follow-up record
